name.ja: HGBD 1/144 ビルドガンマガンダム

description.ja: 一 発 必 中 ―
description.en: One shot required -

description.ja: フォース「魂太」を率いるリーダー機
description.en: Leader machine that leads Force "Konta"

description.ja: 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズブレイク』に登場する、リック・ディアスをベースにしたダイバー「オノコ」の愛機が商品化！
description.en: The favorite machine of the diver "Onoko " based on Rick Diaz that appears in " Gundam Build Divers Break" has been commercialized!

description.ja: 頭部や武装などの専用パーツの他、本体の一部に新規造形パーツを交えて、スタイリングを忠実に再現。
description.en: In addition to special parts such as the head and weapons, some new modeling parts are included to faithfully reproduce the styling.

description.ja: さらに関節パーツをアップデートし、可動性能が大幅に向上！
description.en: Furthermore, the joint parts have been updated, and the movement performance has been greatly improved!

description.ja: ●　各所に新規パーツを採用し、スタイリングを忠実に再現！
description.en: ● Adopts new parts in various places and faithfully reproduces the styling!

description.ja: ＨＧＵＣ リック・ディアスをベースに頭部やシールドバインダー、ビームガトリングバズ、特徴的な各種ディテール部を新規造形で再現。
description.en: Based on HGUC Rick Diaz, the head, Seal binder, beam gatling buzz, and various characteristic details are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: さらにリック・ディアスと共通形状であるパーツも一部を新規造形で用意し、スタイリングを向上。
description.en: In addition, some of the parts with the same shape as Rick Diaz have been newly molded to improve the styling.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: アンテナとフェイス部が特徴的な頭部は、完全新規造形で再現。
description.en: The head, which has a distinctive antenna and face, is reproduced with a completely new model.

description.ja: ビームガトリングバズ
description.en: beam gatling buzz

description.ja: 大ボリュームの専用武装「ビームガトリングバズ」を新規造形を交え立体化。
description.en: The large-volume special weapon "Beam Gatling Buzz" is now three-dimensional with new modeling.

description.ja: 砲身及びフォアグリップには可動ギミックを搭載。特徴的なスコープのレンズ部にはクリアパーツを採用。
description.en: The gun barrel and foregrip are equipped with movable gimmicks. Clear parts are used for the lens part of the distinctive scope.

description.ja: シールドバインダー
description.en: Seal binder

description.ja: 新たなデザインの背部シールドバインダーを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The newly designed back seal binder is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　各関節をアップデートし、ダイナミックなポージングが可能
description.en: ● Each joint has been updated to allow for dynamic poses.

description.ja: 肘、膝、股間の関節を新規パーツに変更し、最新のＨＧフォーマットに準じた可動性能を獲得。
description.en: The elbow, knee, and groin joints have been replaced with new parts to achieve movement performance in line with the latest HG format.

description.ja: 多彩なアクションポーズを再現可能。
description.en: A variety of action poses can be reproduced.

description.ja: 肘関節
description.en: elbow joint

description.ja: 前腕の可動範囲が大幅に拡大。
description.en: The range of motion of the forearm has been greatly expanded.

description.ja: 膝関節
description.en: knee joint

description.ja: 二重関節の採用で可動域を大幅に拡大。また、可動時に露出する部分も見映えを配慮した形状に。
description.en: The use of double joints greatly expands the range of motion. In addition, the parts that are exposed when moving are shaped with consideration to appearance.

description.ja: 股関節
description.en: hip joint

description.ja: 軸を介したロール式の関節タイプに変更。腿側の軸受け部分も可動し、フレキシブルな動きを実現。
description.en: Changed to a roll type joint type via the axis. The bearing part on the thigh side is also movable, allowing for flexible movement.

description.ja: 付属武装：　ビームガトリングバズ ／ ビーム・ピストル ／ ビーム・サーベル ／ シールドバインダー
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam Gatling Buzz / Beam Pistol / Beam Saber / Seal Binder

description.ja: 1/144スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：8才以上
description.en: Target age: 8 years old and above
